name: dsh-principles-audit
description: Principle-library auditor for DeepSeek Harness: one principles_audit tool that checks a principle library for principle_id collisions, legacy ids, missing causal statements, boundaries, counter-examples or evidence, duplicate and near-duplicate principles, status-versus-confidence inconsistencies, stale entries and dimension-coverage gaps, then reports severity-ranked findings plus a pass/warn/fail gate. Read-only.
